summary: P1 meets its outcome: the seven pins live only in the stage files on build 523 (verified the newest dev-<n> the registry actually holds), chart/values.yaml names none, and the chart's required-guards genuinely fail a stage missing any one — proven by mutating both guards away, after which helm exits 0 rendering an untagged image and a null worker. The gate rewrite loses no prior coverage and its --set <path>=null check is a real, non-vacuous mutation test. No findings.
